The '''Elrood sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located along the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]] in the [[Metharian Nebula Territories]]. It contained the [[Degan Gas Clouds]] and the [[The Drift/Legends|Kuras Drift]], which surrounded many planetary [[Star system/Legends|systems]].

==History==
[[File:Elrood_sector.jpg|thumb|left|220px|The Elrood sector and its surrounding sectors]]
The [[Sector/Legends|sector]] was named after [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Elrood (senator)|Elrood]], who fought to secure the funding for the colonization effort.<ref name="PotG3" /> A few [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the sector struggled against the threat of a [[Marauding Dark Jedi|band]] of marauding [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]], who were ultimately defeated by a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] strike team under the command of [[Jorus C'baoth]].<ref name="RGRCR" />

Just before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] began in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the sector joined the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="HNN" /> In the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the invaders bypassed the sector.

During [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] rule, it was governed by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Villis Andal]], who commanded the [[Elrood Sector Fleet]]. [[Chau Feswin]] represented the sector in the [[New Republic Senate/Legends|New Republic Senate]]. [[Elrood StarYards, Ltd.]] was based in this sector.

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the sector was the site of a violent [[Spreading the Rebellion|campaign]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] and Imperial forces.<ref name="BoP" /> Following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the Elrood sector was among the first sectors to throw off the Empire.<ref name="RECG" />
